text: いつ　きても　この　ポケモン　ジムは　しまっとる　いったい　どんな　ヤツが　リーダーを　しとるんじゃろか？

structure.jp: この　ポケモン　ジムは　しまっとる
いったい　どんな　ヤツが　リーダーを　しとるんじゃろか？
structure.en: what on earth kind of person is the Leader, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A question word plus a て-form verb and も means 'no matter when'. いつ きても = 'whenever I come'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is the old-man short form of ている, which shows a state that is still going on. しまっとる = 'is closed'.

patterns.name: 〜だろうか
patterns.explanation: だろうか means 'I wonder'; じゃろか is the old-man way of saying it. しとるんじゃろか = 'who is doing it, I wonder'.
